speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Health what is being done by the Government to fast-track the development and launch of mRNA-based vaccines for cancer in Singapore.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Before that, I will declare my interest as the chairman of a consultancy that does work in the biomedical space, among other verticals.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: I am wondering if MOH is also, in addition to what the Senior Minister of State shared, positioning Singapore as a hub for clinical trials for mRNA cancer treatment and cancer vaccines to the global biopharmaceutical industry, as that may yield some benefits to Singaporean cancer patients.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: All trials related to mRNA vaccines and cancer vaccines will be part of that approach.
